facts.fact: 三人从一级级磨旧的石头楼梯往下走，靠手机灯光照下一级台阶
facts.anchor: The stairs were made of worn stone

facts.fact: 朱迪思用光柱照向石板地面，在灰尘里看见极淡的脚印
facts.anchor: the faintest of footsteps in the dust

facts.fact: 朱迪思厉声招呼两个朋友壮起胆来跟上自己
facts.anchor: ‘Let’s show a bit of mettle. Follow me.’

facts.fact: 朱迪思顺着墙摸到通风口，一推护墙板 hinged open，露出后面的门
facts.anchor: A section of panelling hinged open, revealing a door.

facts.fact: 洞厅一侧是厨房区，摆着双层酒柜和洗碗机
facts.anchor: washing-up area with what looked like a dishwasher

facts.fact: 那片洞穴因此得名“地狱火洞穴”
facts.anchor: the caves became known as the Hellfire Caves

facts.fact: 苏齐猜有人发现了 Gary 与 Mike 的秘密并以此勒索钱财
facts.anchor: was making them pay to keep their secret a secret

facts.fact: 艾琳妮警告朱迪思，下次来敲门的将是逮捕她的警察
facts.anchor: it will be the police arresting you for murder
